summary: George Berrington reviewed Fernhill's partner relationships with Daniel Reese and Amira Khan. Advisers still bring 70% of deals, so the aim is earlier and better-fitting introductions. We agreed a tiered adviser programme and new referral partners.

discussion.keyPoints: Amira's list shows 15 advisers, 5 of whom bring most relevant deals.
Daniel suggested tech-specialist accountants and university spin-out offices in Manchester and Leeds.
Larger funds have offered to co-invest; Daniel was cautious about losing the founder relationship.

recommendations.recommendation: Treat the top 5 advisers as tier one with a named partner and a quarterly pipeline call.
Build referral links with 10 tech-specialist accountancy firms in the North West and Yorkshire.
Agree a co-investment arrangement with one larger fund for rounds over £20m.
Sponsor the Manchester tech awards at £15,000.

actions.action: Assign named partners to the top 5 advisers

nextFocus: Look at portfolio founder support and follow-on investment.
nextPreparation: Daniel to bring the current portfolio list with follow-on capacity.

tests.question: How many tier one advisers do we have?
Did we agree to sponsor the tech awards?
